text.home.curriculum.lede: Children practice math, reading, and writing through practical life skills. The program also offers music, yoga, cooking, gardening, art, athletics, take-home reading, and field trips. Some happen during the school day, while others are available by sign-up. +
text.admissions.tuition.summer.body: Summer school (June, July, and August) tuition rates are the same as the preceding school year but enrollment is more flexible, allowing for families to plan time away. No sibling discount applied during summer months. Test Text
